Paddle Sports–specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Paddle Sports marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Fitness or rowing guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Apple Watch water-paddling workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

桨上运动 vs 皮划艇 vs 立式桨板 vs 桨板运动

US pages say "Paddle Sports", "Kayaking", "Canoeing", "Stand-Up Paddleboard", "SUP", or "Paddleboard Workout." China storefront copy often uses 桨上运动 for general Paddle Sports positioning across kayak, canoe, and SUP, 皮划艇 or 皮艇 when gallery frames show kayaking sessions and route summaries, 划艇 or 独木舟 for canoeing workout cards, and 立式桨板, SUP训练, or 桨板运动 when stand-up paddleboard sessions dominate your gallery. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Paddle cadence on water vs rowing stroke rate vs swim stroke count

Paddle cadence and stroke metrics during kayak, canoe, and SUP sessions on water differ from indoor rower stroke rate during ergometer sessions (划船桨频) and from swim stroke count during pool swims (划水次数). Water-paddling cadence frames need paddle-sport vocabulary — not 室内划船 ergometer language on dedicated kayak route screenshots, not 划水次数 on SUP paddle cadence overlays. Rowing stroke-rate frames belong on Rowing scope; swim stroke-count frames belong on Swimming Metrics scope — mention only as contrast when your English page honestly shows both on separate labeled screenshots.

Paddle Sports vs Multisport transition chaining

Single-sport kayak, canoe, or SUP water-paddling sessions (桨上运动 / 皮划艇 / 桨板运动) differ from Multisport session chaining with transition markers (多运动 / 多项目训练 / 转换训练). Paddle-sport session frames need 皮划艇 or 桨板运动 — not 转换训练 on dedicated kayak workout cards. Multisport transition frames belong on Multisport scope — not mixed into paddle-sport captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Paddle Sports vs Rowing ergometer

Kayak, canoe, and SUP sessions on open water differ from indoor rower ergometer workouts and Apple Watch Rowing stroke-rate dashboards. Water-paddling frames need 桨上运动 or 皮划艇 — not 室内划船 or ergometer 桨频 on dedicated kayak route summaries. Indoor rower frames belong on Rowing scope — mention only as contrast when your gallery shows both on separate labeled screenshots.

Outdoor paddle routes vs hiking elevation

GPS paddle route maps on lakes, rivers, and coastal waters differ from hiking elevation gain summaries (徒步爬升) and trail ascent charts. Route frames need water-paddling context — not 徒步爬升 on dedicated kayak route overlays unless your English page honestly shows both sport types on separate labeled frames.
